summary: Fixed Item 7A/8A Buyer/Seller name and address shrink-to-fit and cell padding, Item 13 Applicable Tax Rate tenths digit centering, Schedule 1 text cell padding and screen labels (OCT/TCT/CCT No., Area (sq.m.)), plus Page 2 comb-tick white band, Schedule 1 Classification code, and numeric right-alignment via shared print (8835479d). Remaining item is screen-only (nsh/screens/form input widths).

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Items 7A (Buyer) and 8A (Seller) Name and Registered Address
defects.what: Long names and addresses sat flush against borders and used hardcoded print-overrides font sizes instead of bir-print's dynamic shrink-to-fit.

defects.where: Page 1, Part II Item 13 (Applicable Tax Rate tenths digit, p1c76)
defects.what: The tenths digit '0' sat flush against the left decimal separator bar instead of centered in its box.
Long Buyer's Name (>27 chars) falls back to proportional text rendered over visible vertical comb ticks (owned by neon-4's shared bir-print comb fitting on try/forms-shared-print).
defects.after: form-review/1606/after/print-p2.png (fixed via shared [data-overflow-of] white band at 8835479d)

defects.what: Classification* column prints blank because writer-cells.json has no derived classification code from the selected classification radio.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 1 (continuation), Area, FMV per TD, FMV per BIR, Fair Market Value, and TOTAL cells
defects.what: Numeric and currency amounts are left-aligned without right padding (owned by neon-4's shared bir-print schedule alignment on try/forms-shared-print).
defects.after: form-review/1606/after/print-p2.png (right-aligned via neon-4 shared rule 0f484378 in crates/bir-print/src/frozen_html.rs; no per-form alignment CSS)

defects.where: Part IV Schedule 1, OCT/TCT/CCT No. and Area (sq.m.)
defects.what: Labels used abbreviated 'TCT/OCT/CCT' and 'Area' instead of official 'OCT/TCT/CCT No.' and 'Area (sq.m.)'.

defects.where: Part I (Buyer/Seller Name & Address) and Part IV Schedule 1 (Location)
defects.what: Long text inputs clip horizontally inside narrow (~240px) fields.

shared_changes_wanted: nsh/screens/form/: widen long single-line text inputs (names, addresses, locations).
